facts.before: A nonempty memo-list request could retrieve the memo settings twice within the same handler.
conditions: The saved value controls both list order and display-time conversion.

facts.mechanism: The reviewed diff removes the second settings lookup before it converts the returned memos.

limits: A settings lookup can use the store cache. The source does not establish a database query reduction for every request.
